{{Quote|Typical. Forget the reconstruction of Taris&mdash;I've got to shift everything around and help with some "top secret mission" nonsense!|Colonel Gaff|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Gaff''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] in the [[Republic Army]] who served as the local regimental commander of Republic forces on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. He was ordered by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Elin Garza|Garza]] to assist a [[Havoc Squad]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] with a mission, but was not told what the mission was. Because of that, Gaff was reluctant to help, though his subordinate [[Elara Dorne]] cited a Republic regulation that allowed her to assist Havoc Squad without his intervention.
